data.keyword: What is the best AI video editor for making short videos?

result.keyword: What is the best AI video editor for making short videos?
result.markdown:
If your goal is **making short videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts**, the best choice depends on how much editing you want to do yourself.

Here's how I'd break it down:

If you want... | Best tool | Why
--- | --- | ---
🏆 Best overall | Descript | Edit by editing text, remove filler words, AI captions, eye contact correction, excellent for talking-head videos. [TechSifted](https://techsifted.com/roundups/best-ai-video-editing-tools-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) [Official A.I Ranking](https://officialairanking.com/rankings/2026-08-06-the-ai-video-editors-we-recommend/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
📱 Best free/mobile | CapCut | Fast editing, trendy effects, AI captions, templates, and optimized for short-form content. [TechSifted](https://techsifted.com/roundups/best-ai-video-editing-tools-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) [Wideframe](https://try.wideframe.com/blog/best-ai-video-editors-for-short-form-content/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
🎥 Turn long videos into clips | Opus Clip | Automatically finds highlights and creates Shorts, Reels, and TikToks with captions. [TechSifted](https://techsifted.com/roundups/best-ai-video-editing-tools-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) [Buffer](https://buffer.com/resources/ai-video-tools/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
✨ AI visual effects | Runway | Best for cinematic AI edits, object removal, and creative effects. [TechSifted](https://techsifted.com/roundups/best-ai-video-editing-tools-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) [Magic Hour AI](https://magichour.ai/blog/best-ai-video-editing-tools-for-short-form-content?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
🌐 Browser-based editing | VEED | Easy to use, strong subtitles, translations, and team collaboration. [PrismPoster](https://www.prismposter.com/blog/best-ai-video-editor?utm_source=chatgpt.com) [Top AI Tracker](https://topaitracker.com/rankings/2026-06-24-best-ai-video-editors-for-creators-ranked-by-workflow-and-output/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My recommendations

**For beginners**

- **CapCut** — easiest to learn
- Free version is powerful
- Great if you're posting daily on social media

**For creators making talking videos**

- **Descript** is excellent.
- You edit by changing the transcript like a Word document.
- AI removes "ums," awkward pauses, and adds captions automatically. [TechSifted](https://techsifted.com/roundups/best-ai-video-editing-tools-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) [Official A.I Ranking](https://officialairanking.com/rankings/2026-08-06-the-ai-video-editors-we-recommend/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**For YouTubers**

- Record one 20–60 minute video.
- Upload it to **Opus Clip**.
- Let it generate 10–20 short clips automatically.
- Polish the best ones in CapCut or Descript. [Buffer](https://buffer.com/resources/ai-video-tools/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) [Wideframe](https://try.wideframe.com/blog/best-ai-video-editors-for-short-form-content/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### The workflow many creators use

1. Record a long video.
2. Use **Opus Clip** to find the best moments.
3. Finish editing in **CapCut** or **Descript**.
4. Publish to TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

This combination saves a lot of editing time while still giving you control over the final result. [Buffer](https://buffer.com/resources/ai-video-tools/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) [TechSifted](https://techsifted.com/roundups/best-ai-video-editing-tools-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you're creating **faceless videos**, **AI story videos**, or **podcast clips**, I can also recommend the tools that work best for those specific formats.
